from pathlib import Path
import json, os, subprocess
assert os.geteuid() == 0
assert 'lyra.parental-identity-test=1' in Path('/proc/cmdline').read_text().split()
assert Path('/sys/block/vda/serial').read_text().strip() == 'lyra-admission-test'
assert Path('/sys/block/vdb/serial').read_text().strip() == 'lyra-ref-domain-test'
assert int(Path('/sys/block/vdb/size').read_text()) * 512 == 1024**3
assert Path('/dev/vdb').is_block_device()
assert '/dev/vdb' not in Path('/proc/self/mountinfo').read_text()
assert not subprocess.check_output(['/usr/sbin/wipefs', '--no-act', '/dev/vdb'], text=True).strip()
def run(*args):
    return subprocess.run(args, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
# Last guard immediately before formatting the dedicated blank test disk.
assert 'lyra.parental-identity-test=1' in Path('/proc/cmdline').read_text().split()
assert Path('/sys/block/vdb/serial').read_text().strip() == 'lyra-ref-domain-test'
assert '/dev/vdb' not in Path('/proc/self/mountinfo').read_text()
run('/usr/sbin/mkfs.btrfs', '-f', '/dev/vdb')
uuid = run('/usr/sbin/blkid', '-s', 'UUID', '-o', 'value', '/dev/vdb').stdout.strip()
top = Path('/mnt/lyra-parental-layout-top'); top.mkdir(mode=0o700)
run('/usr/bin/mount', '-t', 'btrfs', '-o', 'subvolid=5', '/dev/vdb', str(top))
try:
    run('/usr/sbin/btrfs', 'subvolume', 'create', str(top/'@lyra-parental'))
    run('/usr/sbin/btrfs', 'subvolume', 'create', str(top/'@lyra-parental-authority'))
finally:
    run('/usr/bin/umount', str(top))
Path('/var/lib/lyra').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
scope=Path('/var/lib/lyra/parental'); authority=Path('/var/lib/lyra/parental-authority')
scope.mkdir(mode=0o700); authority.mkdir(mode=0o700)
run('/usr/bin/mount','-t','btrfs','-o','subvol=@lyra-parental', '/dev/vdb', str(scope))
run('/usr/bin/mount','-t','btrfs','-o','subvol=@lyra-parental-authority', '/dev/vdb', str(authority))
for child in ('catalog','inventory','ledger'):
    (scope/child).mkdir(mode=0o700)
(scope/'catalog'/'catalog.lock').touch(mode=0o600)
(authority/'reference.lock').touch(mode=0o600)
run('/usr/bin/snapper','--no-dbus','-c','lyra-parental','create-config','/var/lib/lyra/parental')
run('/usr/sbin/btrfs','subvolume','show',str(scope/'.snapshots'))
config=Path('/etc/sysconfig/snapper').read_text()
assert 'lyra-parental' in config
fstab=Path('/etc/fstab')
content=fstab.read_text()
lines=[
 f'UUID={uuid} /var/lib/lyra/parental btrfs compress=zstd:3,subvol=/@lyra-parental 0 0',
 f'UUID={uuid} /var/lib/lyra/parental-authority btrfs compress=zstd:3,subvol=/@lyra-parental-authority 0 0',
 f'UUID={uuid} /var/lib/lyra/parental/.snapshots btrfs compress=zstd:3,subvol=/@lyra-parental/.snapshots 0 0',
]
fstab.write_text(content.rstrip()+'
'+'
'.join(lines)+'
')
run('/usr/bin/systemctl','daemon-reload')
snapshot=run('/usr/bin/snapper','--no-dbus','-c','lyra-parental','create','--read-only','--type','single','--cleanup-algorithm','number','--description','initial parental scope','--userdata','important=yes')
print(json.dumps({'formatted_guarded_vdb':True,'uuid':uuid,'scope_subvolume':'/@lyra-parental','authority_subvolume':'/@lyra-parental-authority','snapshots_subvolume':'/@lyra-parental/.snapshots','snapper_registered':True,'first_snapshot':snapshot.stdout.strip(),'fstab_entries':lines},indent=2))
